name: const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> Pin < Ptr >
rule: Unless `Ptr::Target` implements `Unpin`, the caller must ensure that the value referenced by dereferencing `pointer` cannot subsequently be moved out, including by obtaining a `&mut Ptr::Target` and moving out through it.
api: impl < Ptr : Deref > core::pin::Pin < Ptr > { const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> core::pin::Pin < Ptr > }
